title: fable-mode: a Claude Code skill that adds explicit planning, sub-agent delegation
description:
Claude Fable 5 earns its reputation through how it works: explicit multi-stage planning, delegating to sub-agents, and verifying its own output before it trusts it. fable-mode bottles that behavior as a skill. Drop it into Claude Code and it activates that same disciplined loop, planning out the stages, splitting work to sub-agents, and self-checking the results, on whatever model you're running.  #github #opensource 

https://github.com/mrtooher/fable-mode
